geo.privacy: What you type here is only sent to the geocoder when you search and is not stored. Only the rounded coordinates end up in your location.
geo.short: Type at least 2 characters to search.
geo.none: No results found. Try a different spelling or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.found: Choose a result from the list.
geo.filled: Coordinates filled in. Check them and save.
geo.busy: Too many searches in a short time. Try again in a few seconds.
geo.error: Searching is not working right now. Try again later or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.located: Your location has been filled in, rounded to about 100 metres.
geo.denied: Access to your location was denied. Search for an address or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.unavailable: Your location could not be determined. Search for an address or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.insecure: Getting your location only works over a secure connection (https).
tire.dot_help: The last four digits of the DOT code are the week and year of manufacture: 2319 is week 23 of 2019.
tire.pmsf: 3PMSF symbol (mountain with snowflake) on the tire
tire.pmsf_help: Tires with this symbol meet the stricter winter standard; the old M+S marking alone is no longer enough in Germany and France, among others.
